items.title: 15.5.2 Peripheral Nervous System - Cranial & Spinal Nerves (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of cranial and spinal nerves (PDF 40-42).

blocks.text: Peripheral nervous system nerves aur ganglia par mushtamil hai. Nerves axons ke taar (cable) jaise majmooe hain. Ganglia CNS ke bahar cell bodies ke guchhe hain. Jo nerves dimagh se nikalti hain unhein cranial nerves kehte hain, aur jo spinal cord se nikalti hain unhein spinal nerves kehte hain.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab mein chhapa hai ke "jo spinal nerves se nikalti hain unhein spinal nerves kehte hain". Sahi yeh hai ke spinal nerves spinal cord se nikalti hain.
